verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a prefunded balance model, with a single pool of funds or balances per card held in balance accounts linked to cards. Relayed authorisation lets your servers approve or decline each authorization in real time within 2000 ms, with configurable fallback. However, nothing shows your system funding each authorization at the moment of approval, so this is real-time approval from an existing balance, not documented just-in-time funding. Missing for 10: a documented JIT funding mode where your system funds each authorization, documentation comparing the cash-flow tradeoffs of prefunded vs. JIT funding, and independent corroboration.
